WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH:
At Air Manufacturing Innovation (Air MI), we deliver on Nike’s most daring dream: giving every athlete the unparalleled sensation of walking on air. Since Nike introduced the Air sole in 1979, no technology has become more synonymous with Nike than Air. Our teams engineer, make and perfect Nike’s most advanced footwear components. Masters of teamwork, we challenge assumptions in order to get faster, drive efficiency and fine-tune technology to deliver quality performance plastic. At our state-of-the-art facilities, Air MI is taking Air to places that we never thought possible.
WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
As our Air MI Engineering Intern, you will join the Air MI team to assist in the manufacturing of products related to Nike Air Footwear.
The available position may focus on process development, machine optimization, or other related projects. You will be mentored by your area-specific and cross- functional teammates and use your engineering skills to implement product development or continuous improvement solutions as determined by the project(s) to which you are assigned. Alongside your engineering teammates, you may work with other specialists including but not limited to areas such as development, production, costing, maintenance and facilities.
WHAT YOU WILL EXPERIENCE:
In the NIKE, Inc. Summer Internship Program, you’ll contribute to high-priority, real business initiatives that align with the NIKE, Inc. strategic roadmap.
With the guidance of senior leaders and experienced managers, you’ll take ownership of a project that’s been scoped to drive impact. These projects are designed to challenge your critical thinking, further develop your skills and foster effective collaboration while contributing directly to your team’s goals.
This is a 10-week paid internship opportunity with relocation assistance. Curious to know what it’s like to be part of a world-class Internship Program? Check out our recap video from last summer:
Nike Internship Program Recap Video
WHAT YOU BRING:
Qualifications
Enrolled in an undergraduate program with an expected graduation date of December 2027 or Spring 2028
Preferred degrees: Mechanical, Chemical, Plastics, Electrical, Industrial or Manufacturing Engineering or similar field
Strong desire to work in a manufacturing environment required
Resume submission (PDF) required
Skills
Experience in a high-volume and/or high mix manufacturing environment is preferred
Ability to analyze problems, assess data, use basic math and statistics, and deal with ambiguity and frequent changes in priorities
Ability to balance multiple challenging projects simultaneously
Must be comfortable working hands-on
Exposure to Six Sigma/Lean manufacturing principles and concepts
Mynext: Be Empowered to Grow within Nike and Create the Future
This internship – as well as full-time positions – are located within Nike’s Air Manufacturing Innovation (Air MI) facility in Beaverton, OR. posting.description:
The NIKE, Inc. Global Supply Chain & Operations (GSCO) team is the engine that propels product around the world. Our Supply Chain experts ensure that every year, almost a billion units of footwear, apparel and equipment arrive at the right place, at the right time. We plan, make, and position products to deliver on our athlete* promise on a global scale. GSCO strives towards a more responsive, resilient, and responsible supply chain to drive efficiencies and support the rapid evolution and growth of our marketplace and consumers.
WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
Our Global Supply Chain & Operations team is looking for interns with an interest in supporting our global and geo supply chain network and connecting how we make and move products and serve our consumers across our marketplace.
We have exciting internship opportunities across the following teams:
Product Supply Chain: We Make It
Nike’s Product Supply Chain (PSC) team constantly challenges the assumptions about how products are made. We come up with big ideas, test principles, modernize production processes, and work closely with hundreds of manufacturing partners around the world to create innovative products at scale with less waste. We build the source base of the future to ensure consumer needs around the globe are met flexibly and at scale.
Marketplace Supply Chain: We Move It
Nike’s Marketplace Supply Chain (MSC) team is responsible for enabling the best Nike consumer experience by offering the right supply chain and fulfilment services where it matters, and by getting the right product, to the right place, at the right time - in a profitable way. We are continually innovating to meet evolving consumer needs in our growing marketplace.
WHAT YOU WILL EXPERIENCE:
In the NIKE, Inc. Summer Internship Program, you’ll contribute to high-priority, real business initiatives that align with the NIKE, Inc. strategic roadmap.
With the guidance of senior leaders and experienced managers, you’ll take ownership of a project that’s been scoped to drive impact. These projects are designed to challenge your critical thinking, further develop your skills and foster effective collaboration while contributing directly to your team’s goals.
As a Global Supply Chain & Operations Intern, you will have an opportunity to:
Influence Nike’s Sourcing & Manufacturing strategy through:
Creation of metrics, KPIs, and evaluation frameworks
Optimizing new processes for geo-distributed forecasts
Supplier capability landscaping
Process mapping and establishing partner engagement models
Innovate Nike’s approach to Operational Excellence through:
Data analysis and market research on quality of key apparel, accessories, and footwear styles
Streamlining the risk assessment process
Tool building (Tableau, Smartsheet, etc.) to automate processes and visualize data
Operation Model Building
This is a 10-week paid internship opportunity with relocation assistance. Curious to know what it’s like to be part of a world-class Internship Program? Check out our recap video from last summer:
Nike Internship Program Recap Video
WHAT YOU BRING:
Qualifications:
Enrolled in an undergraduate program with an expected graduation date of December 2027 or Spring 2028
Background in Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Analytics, Manufacturing, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Business or related field preferred
0-2 years work experience
Resume submission (PDF) required
Skills:
Ability to build and elevate data-based decision-making models and storytelling across supply chain
Skilled with analytical tools (SQL, Tableau, Excel, Power BI, etc). Python/R nice to have.
Interest and/or experience in machine learning and AI through coursework or other means preferred
Supply Chain operations and retail industry knowledge is a plus
Strong project management, data analytics and strategic thinking skills
Ability to analyze problems, develop innovative solutions, and deal with frequent changes in priorities
Ability to work cross-functionally, influence other teams, and leverage internal and external resources
Have a growth mindset, be inquisitive, and have a process-oriented mindset
Compelling, high-impact storyteller with the ability to influence at multiple levels throughout the organization
Self-directed and comfortable working in ambiguous environments
Mynext: Be Empowered to Grow within Nike and Create the Future
This internship – as well as full-time positions – are located in-person at the NIKE, Inc. Philip H. Knight Campus in Beaverton, OR. Check out this video to learn more about life on campus:
Nike PHK Campus Video

posting.description:
In a world being reshaped by climate change, Nike is relentlessly innovating at scale to help all athletes* perform at their best. We recognize that sustainability is not a compromise – it’s a competitive advantage – and the future of sport depends on the future of our planet.
Across our entire value chain, we drive continuous improvement in how we design, make and deliver products to help reduce emissions and eliminate waste. We work across industries and continents to conserve water resources and develop cleaner chemistries that help minimize environmental impact. We take action every day as only NIKE can to move the world forward through sport and help every athlete* thrive. We do this by driving our enterprise mandate for sustainability and compliance across climate and environment, people and human rights, foundational expectations, marketplace and supply chain.
*If you have a body, you are an athlete.
WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
We are looking for candidates who are passionate about sustainability and Nike and who will leave a lasting impact on our Global Sustainability team. As an Intern, you will work in one of the following areas:
Climate & Environment
Engagement
Geo Sustainability
Marketplace Sustainability
People & Human Rights
Raw Materials & Traceability
Supply Chain Compliance
Sustainable Chemistry
Sustainability Compliance & Reporting
WHAT YOU’LL EXPERIENCE:
In the role of a Nike Global Sustainability Graduate Intern, you will work with teams Globally across Nike to embed sustainability into business, manufacturing, operations, and marketplace initiatives. As a Global Sustainability Intern, you will lead one or more projects that will require you to work across a range of stakeholders, exercise and showcase critical and strategic thinking and problem solving to deliver insights that will move the business forward.
Previous Intern project examples include:
Develop a strategy for how Nike could incorporate carbon offsets in its enterprise climate strategy.
Research and create a playbook on how Nike should elevate its sustainability presence at key running races.
Develop a strategy to enhance sustainability efforts at North America distribution centers.
This is a 10-week paid internship opportunity with relocation assistance. Curious to know what it’s like to be part of a world-class Internship Program? Check out our recap video from last summer:
Nike Internship Program Recap Video
WHAT YOU WILL BRING:
Qualifications:
Enrolled in a Business (MBA) and/or Environmental Science graduate program with an expected graduation date of December 2027 or Spring/Summer 2028
Background in Social and Environmental Sustainability, Operations, Supply Chain, Analytics, Manufacturing, Engineering, Procurement, Textiles, Finance, or Retail preferred
At least 2 years of work experience required
1 page Resume submission (PDF) and 1 page Cover Letter required for consideration (PDF). Please upload and submit as a single combined PDF file.
Skills:
General sustainability skills/knowledge strongly preferred, including experience in corporate responsibility, climate, natural resources, circularity, people and human rights and/or other related topics
Ability to work cross-functionally and influence teams in a highly matrixed organization
Strong project management, problem structuring and solving skills
Self-starter that is comfortable with ambiguity and has a bias for action
Ability to decipher themes, make decisions, and tell stories from large datasets
Experience presenting to diverse audiences, including senior leadership
Have an inquisitive, growth-focused and process-oriented mindset
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Clearly demonstrated passion for sustainability and Nike
This internship – as well as full-time positions – are located in-person at the NIKE, Inc. Philip H. Knight campus in Beaverton, OR. Check out this video of our PHK campus to learn more about life on campus:

Job Summary
NiSource Internship Program Introduction
NiSource is currently seeking a Summer Finance - Financial Planning & Analysis Intern. Successful applicants will become integral members of the department while learning within a team environment, completing meaningful tasks and collaborating with team members and leaders on important projects. This position will be a great opportunity for the candidate desiring to launch their career in this field. Successful applicants will build professional relationships with other interns and all levels of NiSource personnel while participating in rewarding professional development exercises and fun, team-building activities. Interns will obtain a broad overview of NiSource's operations and current events in the utilities industry.
This is a 12-week summer internship program starting in May 2027, for students entering their junior or senior year in fall 2027. The role is based in Columbus, OH. Candidates must reside within 50 miles of the reporting location to be eligible.
Essential Functions
Successful applicants will become integral members of the department, while learning within a team environment, completing meaningful tasks and collaborating with managers on important projects. These positions will be a great opportunity for the candidate desiring to launch their career in Finance-related fields. Successful applicants will build professional relationships with other interns and all levels of NiSource personnel while participating in rewarding professional development exercises and fun, team-building activities. Interns will obtain a broad overview of NiSource's operations and current events in the utilities industry.
• Financial Planning Department
◦ The intern will gain hands-on experience in performing functions such as building long range financial plans, budget to actual analysis, preparing operating expense forecasts, developing variance analysis and producing monthly and quarterly management reports.
Required Qualifications For Position
Currently enrolled in an accredited university with major in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or related business discipline
Completion of intermediate-level coursework
Preferred GPA of 3.0 or higher
Strong financial acumen and analytical ability
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Proficiency in MS Excel and Word
Positive attitude and strong work ethic

NLR’s 305-acre Flatirons Campus is the nation’s premier wind energy, water power, and grid integration research facility. Nestled south of Boulder, Colorado, and north of NLR’s main South Table Mountain campus, Flatirons Campus sits adjacent to the Rocky Flats National Wildlife Refuge and countless acres of open space and parks with stunning views of the Flatirons rock formations.
Join the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR), where world-class scientists, engineers, and experts are accelerating energy innovation through breakthrough research and systems integration. From our mission to our collaborative culture, NLR stands out in the research community for its commitment to an affordable and secure energy future. Spanning foundational science to applied systems engineering and analysis, we focus on solving complex challenges to deliver advanced, secure, reliable, and cost-effective energy solutions. Our work helps strengthen U.S. industries, support job creation, and promote national economic growth.
At NLR, you'll find a mission-driven environment supported by state-of-the-art facilities, multidisciplinary research teams, and strong collaborations with industry, academia, and other national laboratories. We offer robust professional development opportunities, and a competitive benefits package designed to support your career and well-being.

The Water Power Technology Validation group performs research to advance wave energy, tidal energy, ocean current energy, riverine energy, and ocean thermal gradient energy technologies (i.e., marine energy technologies) - see
https://www.nlr.gov/water/marine-energy
for more information. In this pursuit we work closely with the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE), industry partners, and academic institutions. The group’s work involves the development of numerical design, control, and optimization software tools, developing new and innovative methods of capturing marine energy, performing laboratory testing, and supporting open-ocean testing.
Assist in developing simulations for power electronic converter topologies.
Perform design calculations for component sizing of passive circuit elements, operating specifications and evaluating off-the-shelf converter solutions.
Implement control methods for power capture and power conditioning, e.g., maximum power point tracking.
The hired candidate will have the opportunity to work on- and familiarize themselves with a wide range of marine energy applications, while developing their core skillset and gaining practical experience. There is also the potential for publishing their contributions and work done during the internship.

.

.

.

.
Working at NLR
NLR is located at the foothills of the Rocky Mountains in Golden, Colorado is the nation's primary laboratory for energy systems research and development.
Join the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR), where world-class scientists, engineers, and experts are accelerating energy innovation through breakthrough research and systems integration. From our mission to our collaborative culture, NLR stands out in the research community for its commitment to an affordable and secure energy future. Spanning foundational science to applied systems engineering and analysis, we focus on solving complex challenges to deliver advanced, secure, reliable, and cost-effective energy solutions. Our work helps strengthen U.S. industries, support job creation, and promote national economic growth.
At NLR, you'll find a mission-driven environment supported by state-of-the-art facilities, multidisciplinary research teams, and strong collaborations with industry, academia, and other national laboratories. We offer robust professional development opportunities, and a competitive benefits package designed to support your career and well-being.
Job Description
The Geospatial Data Science (GDS) team within the Strategic Energy Analysis Center at the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR) is seeking a 6–12-month intern to support modeling and analysis. The GDS group conducts research at the intersection of energy deployment, big data science, and geospatial modeling and visualization. Our team of researchers develops and applies geospatial algorithms and methods to evaluate the deployment potential for energy technologies, including geothermal, hydropower, transmission, bioenergy, wind, and solar. Geospatial modeling at NLR enables detailed techno-economic assessment, capacity expansion, and power systems modeling of energy resources under a variety of regulatory, sociopolitical, and environmental factors from local to continental scales.
The successful intern candidate will support a large and diverse modeling portfolio with activities involving geospatial analyses, literature reviews, cartography, scientific programming, and tasks focused on data preparation, processing, and validation. This position will assist geospatial scientists in developing novel analytical solutions to complex challenges in energy siting, deployment, and adoption. Candidates should be interested in working in an interdisciplinary field, together with geospatial data scientists, software developers, and policy analysts, which will require excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Duties will include:
Manipulating multiple data sources, models, and software tools with scientific and engineering workflows for decision support and data analysis
Preparing and processing geospatial data using open-source desktop software and programmatic approaches
Conducting background research on data sets, current modeling approaches, and existing tools
Developing literature reviews under the guidance of research scientists
Programming and scripting in Python to conduct analysis and visualize data
Working in distributed computing environments including internal servers, NLR's high-performance computing (HPC) system and the Cloud
.

Minimum of a 3.0 cumulative grade point average.
Undergraduate: Must be enrolled as a full-time student in a bachelor’s degree program from an accredited institution.

To be considered, all candidates must include in their resume and an online code repository such as GitHub with several publicly visible coding projects. Demonstrated experience working independently with programming skills in python and libraries such as geopandas, numpy, scipy, shapely, pyproj
Proficiency and experience with geospatial analysis and modeling techniques using open-source tools, such as QGIS; (please note that ESRI tools are not used in this research group)
Experience working with geographic transformations and projections

Benefits Summary
Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; 403(b) Employee Savings Plan with employer match*; and sick leave (where required by law). NLR employees may be eligible for, but are not guaranteed, performance-, merit-, and achievement- based awards that include a monetary component. NXP’s Technology & Operations organization plays an essential role in the company’s success by ensuring the delivery of high quality, scalable, cost-competitive technologies and supply to create a competitive advantage for our customers.

Primary responsibilities include functional yield enhancement (wafer probe), maintaining and improving parametric process control, developing integration changes to reduce cost or enhance device functionality.

Specific projects may include a facet of integration development or integration optimization.

posting.description:
Job Description
Job Title:
DFT Intern
Location:
Austin, TX (On-site/Hybrid)
Department:
Digital Design – DFT
Reports To:
DFT Engineer / Manager
About the Role:
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented
Design for Test (DFT) Intern
to join our Digital Design team. As a DFT Intern, you will work closely with experienced engineers to support the development and implementation of DFT methodologies for cutting-edge SoC designs. This internship offers hands-on experience in scan insertion, ATPG, MBIST, and other test-related flows in a real-world semiconductor environment.
Key Responsibilities:
Assist in the implementation of DFT techniques such as scan insertion, boundary scan, and memory BIST.
Support ATPG pattern generation and validation using industry-standard tools.
Help with test coverage analysis and debug of test patterns.
Collaborate with RTL designers and verification teams to ensure testability requirements are met.
Contribute to automation of DFT flows using scripting languages (e.g., Python, Perl, TCL).
Document DFT methodologies, test plans, and results.
Qualifications:
Currently pursuing a
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
Strong understanding of digital logic design and VLSI fundamentals.
Familiarity with Verilog/VHDL and scripting languages (Python, Perl, or TCL).
Exposure to DFT concepts such as scan chains, ATPG, and BIST is a plus.
Experience with EDA tools from Synopsys, Cadence, or Mentor Graphics is desirable.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Strong communication and teamwork abilities.
Preferred Skills (Nice to Have):
Coursework or project experience in DFT or digital IC design.
Knowledge of STA, synthesis, and RTL verification.
Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments.
What You’ll Gain:
Hands-on experience with industry-standard DFT tools and flows.
Mentorship from experienced engineers in a collaborative environment.
Exposure to the full ASIC design and test cycle.
Opportunity to contribute to real silicon projects.
In order to be considered for a summer internship with NXP you must be returning to school or graduating at the conclusion of the internship term. If you are graduating prior to July 2027 please apply to Entry Level full-time roles.

Student working towards a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or other related field.

About Pratt Miller, an Oshkosh company
Pratt Miller is a product development company in motorsports, defense, and mobility industries providing clients with product engineering and low-volume production solutions. Our range of research & development, engineering, prototype manufacturing, test & validation, and low-rate production capability help our customers bring their high-quality products to market faster.
We are seeking a talented and motivated Autonomy Engineering intern to join our dynamic team. This internship offers an exciting opportunity to work on real-world projects and gain hands-on experience in the field of autonomous systems. As an intern, you will collaborate with experienced engineers and researchers to develop and test advanced algorithms and technologies.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Assist in the development and implementation of autonomous navigation, perception, or control algorithms.
Analyze and interpret data from sensors and other sources to improve system performance.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate autonomy solutions into various platforms.
Document and present findings and progress to the engineering team.
QUALIFICATIONS:
At Pratt Miller, we believe that diverse perspectives and backgrounds lead to innovative solutions. We encourage individuals from all walks of life to apply, even if you don’t meet every single requirement. If you’re passionate about autonomous technology and eager to learn, we want to hear from you!
Currently pursuing an MS or PhD (preferred) in Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field; BS candidates with relevant coursework, project experience, or demonstrated technical skills will also be considered.
Proficiency in C/C++ programming
Experience with ROS1 or ROS2 (Robot Operating System) and Linux
Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive attitude
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Hands-on experience with autonomous systems through research, coursework, projects, competitions, or previous internships

Position requires light physical activity.
Daytime schedule Monday-Friday with infrequent night/weekend work for project surge support and additional effort as needed to achieve deadlines.

posting.description:
About Pratt Miller, an Oshkosh company
Pratt Miller is a product development company in motorsports, defense, and mobility industries providing clients with product engineering and low-volume production solutions. Our range of research & development, engineering, prototype manufacturing, test & validation, and low-rate production capability help our customers bring their high-quality products to market faster.
Pratt & Miller Engineering is seeking an enthusiastic and detailed oriented Product Intern to work closely with a talented cross-functional engineering and manufacturing team on the execution of low-volume production programs.
As a Product Intern, you will focus on a growing portfolio of Defense Products while taking ownership and daily responsibility for work-products throughout each phase of the full product lifecycle. Reporting to the Product Director, you will be working within an energetic team focused on fast-paced product development and unsurpassed quality. Typical Defense Products may include items like: vehicle upfit kits, mobility enhancement components, weapon system components and integration kits, radar/surveillance systems, security systems, defense platforms, Counter-UAV solutions, and advanced military vehicles. Effective collaboration and communications with customers, suppliers, engineering, purchasing, quality, manufacturing, and sales is critical to being successful in this position.
POSITION DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
· Manage and track all program requirements
· Participate in all prototype design, build, testing, and development activities
· Help influence the product design in the early stages with focus on manufacturability, commonality, quality, and lessons learned
· Create and maintain BOM’s with critical component information
· Work with purchasing on supplier selection and production parts procurement
· Support and understand all phases of the production fabrication, manufacturing, and assembly process
· Own product cost targets and execute a plan to meet/exceed them
· Track incoming and in-process quality metrics
· Determine and implement corrective actions as needed and generate ECR’s
· Ensure early prototype design and build efforts are transferable to Low Rate Production
· Lead core production team meetings and be the conduit that unites all key functions
· Direct customer interface with in-person support in remote and international locations
· Manage product warranty, scrap, obsolescence, and spares activity
· Ask the hard questions and challenge team members to drive accountability/ownership
· Function as the product expert
ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:
Required Experience and Education:
· Broad knowledge of automotive/military vehicle systems engineering
· Previous experience with low-volume production programs is highly desired
· Knowledge of Product Development Tools and Processes is essential
· Strong technical writing, communication, organization and customer service skills
· Proficiency with ERP tools and MS Office
· Understanding of ITAR Licensing classifications
· US Citizenship or Permanent Residency is required
· Proactive mentality with outstanding multitasking capabilities
· Ability to function independently in a fast paced and sometimes stressful environment
Desired Experience and Education:
· CAD and GD&T experience is a plus
· Defense industry experience is a plus
· Vehicle/System testing and manufacturing engineering experience is a plus
· Logistics Product Data (LPD) process experience is a plus
WORK ENVIRONMENT
Work will typically be performed in a team-based office environment. Our team members work on collaborative, challenging projects that offer the opportunity to learn from a wide range of expertise. Travel (up to 20%) may be required for customer and supplier meetings, off-site training, off-site testing, and attendance at industry conferences.

We employ over 18,000 team members all united by a common purpose. Our engineering and product innovation help keep soldiers and firefighters safe, is critical in building and keeping communities clean and helps people do their jobs every day.
THE ROLE
As an
AI Engineer Intern
in Summer 2027, you will contribute to the development and deployment of artificial intelligence and intelligent software solutions across Oshkosh’s engineering and product platforms.
Depending on your experience, interests, and project assignment, you may work in areas such as
machine learning, computer vision, edge AI, embedded systems, vehicle intelligence, connectivity, or software-defined vehicle technologies
. You’ll collaborate with engineering and technology teams to develop, test, and integrate intelligent solutions into real-world products and applications.
YOUR IMPACT
As an AI Engineer Intern, your responsibilities may include:
Designing, training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning and AI models on GPU servers, cloud platforms, or edge devices
Processing and analyzing structured and unstructured datasets, including imagery and sensor data
Developing data pipelines and model deployment workflows from cloud to edge
Integrating AI/ML models into applications, embedded systems, electronic control units (ECUs), or vehicle platforms
Assisting in the development of software modules supporting vehicle intelligence, connectivity, automation, and advanced features
Testing embedded and AI-enabled applications across hardware, vehicle networks, and software environments
Using simulation environments and testing frameworks to validate algorithms, models, and system functionality
Conducting experiments and benchmarking algorithms for performance, accuracy, and efficiency
Supporting software integration, over-the-air (OTA) capabilities, and vehicle software lifecycle activities
Participating in code reviews, technical discussions, system architecture development, and innovation activities
Documenting system designs, test procedures, model behavior, performance metrics, and experimental results

Pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in
Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science
, or a related technical field
Coursework or experience in one or more of the following areas:
artificial intelligence, machine learning, computer vision, embedded systems, software development, or statistics
Programming experience with
Python, C++, or other relevant programming or scripting languages
Familiarity with Linux environments
Interest in applying AI and software technologies to real-world engineering and product challenges
Willingness to travel or relocate to Oshkosh, WI for the summer internship
(Housing provided for interns living more than 50 miles from the work location)

Experience or exposure to one or more of the following is a plus:
Machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn
Computer vision and image processing
GPU or NPU computing
Edge AI and model optimization/deployment
Embedded software and embedded computing platforms
Vehicle communication technologies such as CAN
AUTOSAR or automotive software architectures
Vehicle connectivity and software-defined vehicle concepts
Cloud-to-edge architectures and data pipelines
Simulation, testing, or automated validation frameworks

posting.description:
At Oshkosh, we build, serve and protect people and communities around the world by designing and manufacturing some of the toughest specialty trucks and access equipment. We employ over 18,000 team members all united by a common purpose. Our engineering and product innovation help keep soldiers and firefighters safe, is critical in building and keeping communities clean and helps people do their jobs every day.
JOB SUMMARY
As a
year-round Cybersecurity Intern
, you will help protect Oshkosh Corporation’s information, systems, and technology while gaining hands-on experience across multiple areas of cybersecurity.
Depending on your background, interests, and project assignment, you may support
security operations and incident response, cyber defense engineering, security infrastructure, or security technology administration
. You’ll work alongside cybersecurity professionals to investigate real-world security events, support enterprise security technologies, improve security controls, and help strengthen Oshkosh’s overall security posture.
This internship provides exposure to both the technical and operational sides of cybersecurity while giving you the opportunity to develop practical skills, work with industry tools, and understand how cybersecurity supports a global organization.
YOUR IMPACT
As a Cybersecurity Intern, your responsibilities may include:
Working alongside Security Operations, Incident Response, and Cyber Defense teams
Investigating phishing emails, malware, security alerts, and other cybersecurity events
Supporting the technologies used by the Cyber Defense team, including day-to-day operations, maintenance, upgrades, and lifecycle management
Assisting with the administration, configuration, and troubleshooting of security applications and infrastructure
Participating in patching, deployment, and upgrades of security applications and agents
Troubleshooting and remediating cybersecurity tickets based on priority
Supporting security logging across the enterprise, including adding, updating, troubleshooting, and decommissioning security logs

We employ over 18,000 team members all united by a common purpose. Our engineering and product innovation help keep soldiers and firefighters safe, is critical in building and keeping communities clean and helps people do their jobs every day.
YOUR IMPACT
We’re currently recruiting for a data driven, motivated and passionate Data Engineer Intern to join our Advanced Analytics team. This is a practical, hands-on experience on a fast paced, energetic, high visibility team. You will experience a culture that recognizes hard work and values people. As a Data Engineer Intern, you’ll be assisting the Advanced Analytics team in working in our cloud environments to create data pipelines to support our internal customers. You will do this through partnering with data scientists and analysts to understand their pain points, goals and objectives, and then crafting innovative solutions.
This position is located in person at our global headquarters facility in Oshkosh, WI.
JOB Description
These duties are not meant to be all-inclusive and other duties may be assigned:
Collaborate with the data science team to understand a key business problem and work to source and deliver data.

Consult with internal customers to collect reporting and data requirements.
Consult with business and Digital Technology partners on data quality issues.
Partner with leaders to develop innovative ways to deliver timely and accurate data.
Utilize Databricks, Azure Cloud, Qlik Replicate and other tools to source and deliver data.
Assist in the preparation and development of analytics and data science presentations for executive leadership.
Research and share key insights on emerging technologies with business value potential which align with our analytics objectives.
Support our Digital Technology strategic pillars, Reach (to innovate), Rearchitect (to grow) and Resiliency (to enhance core)
Identify and propose continuous improvement ideas.

Currently enrolled in a master’s program in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field

Experience with Python as a data transformation tool
Knowledge of relational database concepts
Knowledge of SQL
Knowledge of building reports and visualization
Knowledge of Microsoft Office
Familiar with stages of analytics lifecycle include data extraction, validation, and cleansing.

Ability to communicate with internal/external entities
Ability to work independently while prioritizing workload

Internship experience in the Global IT field, particularly experience in IT implementations or change efforts

This role is primarily performed in a professional office environment with standard lighting, ventilation, and temperature-controlled settings.

We employ over 18,000 team members all united by a common purpose. Our engineering and product innovation help keep soldiers and firefighters safe, is critical in building and keeping communities clean and helps people do their jobs every day.
THE ROLE
The Industrial Design Intern supports the team in conceptualizing new, modified, or improved products using 2D and 3D tools. The role includes creating deliverables such as sketches, renderings, 3D models, and presentations.
Through
this position, you will develop an understanding of customer requirements and translate them into design solutions. This role collaborates closely with engineering throughout vehicle development to integrate styling and branding while ensuring strong customer value.
YOUR IMPACT

Generating fresh ideas through sketches, models, visualizations, research, and other forms of creative exploration
Developing visual and design deliverables such as renderings, 3D models, animations, prototypes, presentations, and digital experiences
Collaborating with engineers and cross-functional teams to translate ideas and user needs into meaningful design solutions
Exploring emerging design tools and technologies, including VR/mixed reality, AI-assisted design, real-time visualization, and rapid prototyping
Applying human-centered design principles to create solutions that balance usability, functionality, experience, styling, and brand identity
Using digital and physical prototyping to explore, evaluate, and communicate concepts and user experiences
Supporting the Oshkosh visual brand language across vehicles, products, interfaces, and experiences
Researching design trends, user needs, visualization techniques, emerging technologies, and competitor products to inform and inspire design
Adapting to shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining quality and detail
Growing as a designer through mentorship, feedback, and opportunities to present work

Intern – New Product Development Engineer – Colorado Springs, CO – Summer 2027

Your role:
Design and build prototypes and processes for new product development
Work with R&D management and project team members to design and implement research and product development program plans.
Support the design and execution of experimental plans and interpretation of data from the testing.
Documenting and reporting of design and development work.
Work with project teams to transfer processes to manufacturing.

Working towards a Bachelor's Degree Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemistry, Biology or related field required.
Experience with CAD and prototyping techniques.
Experience with data analysis and software (Excel) Knowledge of safe laboratory practices

How we work together
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. .
JOB DESCRIPTION AND POSITION REQUIREMENTS
We are seeking Undergraduate and Graduate Student Co-ops to join the Navigation Research and Development Division (NRDD), of The Applied Research Laboratory (ARL) at Penn State, located in
Warminster, PA
, to support research, development, and engineering activities.
NRDD is focused on developing the most advanced navigation technologies in the world, built around unique laboratories specially designed to test the most precise navigation sensors and systems. The mission of the NRDD is to conduct new navigation technology research and development, systems engineering and to provide expert knowledge for our Navy, Army, and other U.S. government sponsors.
As an embedded systems and hardware co-op you will:
Support laboratory operations related to the development, testing, and evaluation of navigation systems
Work with a cooperative team of scientists and engineers responsible for a mix of hands on work, entry level electrical/mechanical design and software and/or firmware development
Work on several projects such as designing and building hardware to interface with state-of-the-art equipment and instrumentation, programming software to interface with this equipment, software for logging/processing test data, test fixture design, performing tests and analyzing data
Learn or strengthen practical skills such as C++/C#/Python/MATLAB programming, drafting electrical schematics, solid modeling, hardware interfacing, and electrical fabrication.
Students studying Electrical Engineering and Computer Engineering are preferred.
Students must be available to work at the Warminster facility for a six month time period.
Penn State’s Applied Research Laboratory (ARL) is a Department of Defense (DoD) designated University Affiliated Research Center (UARC), which serves as a center of research excellence in a multitude of areas. ARL conducts basic and applied research, exploratory development, and advanced development in support of the U.S. government organizations; contributes to the educational objectives and research goals of Penn State; and promotes the transfer of advanced technology to the U.S. government.
You will be subject to a government security investigation, and you must be a U.S. citizen to apply. Employment with the ARL will require successful completion of a pre-employment drug screen.
FOR FURTHER INFORMATION on ARL, visit our web site at
www.arl.psu.edu
.
BACKGROUND CHECKS/CLEARANCES
Employment with the University will require successful completion of background check(s) in accordance with University policies.
Notice regarding employment at the Applied Research Laboratory (ARL):
Employees must be eligible to obtain a government security clearance, participate in the ARL drug testing program, and comply with electronic and physical monitoring requirements applicable to federal contractors. ARL operates in a secure information environment involving Unclassified, Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), and Classified information. Personal electronic devices brought onsite must be registered and may be restricted from certain areas. You must be a U.S. citizen to apply.
CAMPUS SECURITY CRIME STATISTICS
Pursuant to the Jeanne Clery Disclosure of Campus Security Policy and Campus Crime Statistics Act and the Pennsylvania Act of 1988, Penn State publishes a combined Annual Security and Annual Fire Safety Report (ASR). The ASR includes crime statistics and institutional policies concerning campus security, such as those concerning alcohol and drug use, crime prevention, the reporting of crimes, sexual assault, and other matters. The ASR is available for review
here
.
EEO IS THE LAW
Penn State is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. If you are unable to use our online application process due to an impairment or disability, please contact 814-865-1473.

As a global leader in digital infrastructure, QTS designs, builds and operates advanced data centers that support strategic AI, cloud and digital transformation initiatives. We are driven by a mission to connect the world for good and our people make it possible. posting.description:
Job Description Summary
Job Description
Raymond James Overview
One of the largest independent financial services firms in the country could be the place where you build a career beyond your expectations.
Our focus is on providing trusted advice and tailored, sophisticated strategies for individuals and institutions. Raymond James Financial is a diversified holding company headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida. Raymond James provides financial services to individuals, corporations, and municipalities through its subsidiary companies engaged primarily in investment and financial planning, in addition to capital markets and asset management.
At Raymond James, we are putting the Power of Personal into action and building an inclusive and diverse workforce that reflects our commitment to associates and clients of the future. Our company values associate development and growth, offering opportunities through developmental programs, mentorships, and continuing education options.
We strive to ensure everyone feels welcomed, valued, respected, and heard so that you can fully contribute your unique talents for the benefit of clients, your career, our firm, and our communities. Raymond James is an equal opportunity employer and makes all employment decisions on the basis of merit and business needs.
Internship Program Overview
Raymond James is the place where good people grow and nowhere is that better demonstrated than in our internship program. During this immersive experience, you will engage with and implement the firm's core values through our five guiding behaviors. Featuring comprehensive orientation, onsite and remote training sessions in professional development, networking events, a speaker series, and volunteer opportunities, you will gain valuable knowledge of our business and culture while developing skills and relationships that support your future career.
To be eligible for the Summer 2027 Internship Program, you must be a junior-standing candidate pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree with an expected graduation date between December 2027 and May 2028.
Candidates who successfully complete the internship program may have the opportunity to transition into a full-time role at Raymond James following graduation.
Department Overview
Raymond James Bank's Private Client Banking (PCB) division supports the complex financial needs of clients by offering a comprehensive suite of lending and banking solutions, including Securities Based Lending (SBL), residential mortgages, tailored lending solutions and cash management products.
PCB combines field-based Banking Consultants with Home Office sales, analytics, pricing, product management, risk, finance, and operational support teams to deliver exceptional client outcomes.
This internship provides exposure to multiple areas of the lending business, including advisor engagement, sales enablement, pricing strategy, product management, business intelligence, portfolio analytics, and strategic decision making. Interns will gain hands-on experience supporting initiatives that drive growth, profitability, advisor adoption, and client engagement across the Securities Based Lending and Mortgage businesses.
Job Summary
Under general supervision, the Private Client Banking Strategy, Analytics & Sales Intern will support strategic initiatives across the Securities Based Lending (SBL), Mortgage, Margin, and Tailored Lending businesses. The intern will work closely with teams responsible for sales enablement, advisor support, education and engagement, pricing strategy, business analytics, portfolio management, product management, finance, and risk management.
This role combines analytical and business-focused responsibilities, including dashboard development, performance reporting, financial modeling, Return on Equity (ROE) analysis, pricing strategy, advisor support, educational content development, competitive research, and strategic project work. The intern will gain exposure to the full lending lifecycle and develop an understanding of how lending products are positioned, priced, managed, and supported across Raymond James Bank.
This internship is designed to provide meaningful exposure to lending product strategy, advisor engagement, pricing optimization, portfolio analytics, and business development, preparing participants for future careers within Raymond James Bank and the broader financial services industry.
Start Date:
June 2, 2027 (based on internship program schedule)
End Date:
August 13, 2027 (based on internship program schedule)
Work Schedule:
Monday through Friday, up to 40 hours per week
Duties and Responsibilities
Analytics, Reporting & Business Intelligence
Analyze lending, sales, operational, and portfolio data to support strategic initiatives and business decision-making.
Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions using Tableau, Excel, Qlik, SQL, Access, Power BI, and other business intelligence tools.
Create reports measuring loan production, advisor adoption, utilization trends, commission activity, portfolio growth, profitability, and client engagement metrics.
Support forecasting, financial modeling, performance measurement, and business case analyses.
Collect, organize, validate, and analyze information from multiple data sources to ensure reporting accuracy and integrity.
Prepare management reporting packages, executive summaries, and presentations highlighting business performance, key trends, and recommendations.
Securities Based Lending (SBL) Support
Support the Securities Based Lending Consulting team by analyzing production metrics, advisor adoption trends, utilization rates, and portfolio performance.
Assist with advisor and branch professional inquiries regarding SBL products, processes, educational resources, and sales support materials.
Participate in portfolio reviews to identify growth opportunities and trends affecting client utilization and advisor adoption.
Assist with annual reviews of discounted lending relationships and evaluate pricing performance and profitability implications.
Support development and maintenance of advisor-facing SBL presentations, educational content, and communication materials.
Conduct competitive analysis and market research related to securities-based lending products and pricing strategies.
Mortgage Business Support
Analyze mortgage production, application volume, pipeline activity, referral trends, and funding performance.
Assist in evaluating mortgage pricing competitiveness and business performance.
Support mortgage reporting initiatives and performance tracking.
Create advisor-facing educational materials and communications supporting mortgage solutions.
Assist in measuring the success of mortgage campaigns, advisor engagement efforts, and growth initiatives.
Collaborate with Mortgage Sales, Operations, and Product Management teams on strategic projects and process improvement initiatives.
Pricing Strategy & Product Management
Support pricing activities for Securities Based Lending, Mortgage, Margin, and Tailored Lending products.
Assist in pricing new loans utilizing Return on Equity (ROE) methodologies.
Conduct profitability assessments, break-even analyses, and modeling of proposed pricing programs and promotional campaigns.
Analyze portfolio performance and identify trends impacting product profitability and business growth.
Assist Product and Pricing Strategy teams with product reviews, competitive assessments, and strategic initiatives.
Support development of analytical tools and models designed to improve account-level pricing, portfolio management, and business insights.
Recommend enhancements to reporting, modeling, and pricing tools that improve business decision-making.
Sales Enablement & Advisor Support
Respond to routine inquiries from advisors, branch professionals, Banking Consultants, and internal business partners.
Assist with development and distribution of educational materials, presentations, sales resources, and internal communications.
Maintain communication hubs, reporting repositories, and shared team resources.
Support coordination of meetings, webinars, training programs, educational events, and advisor engagement initiatives.
Conduct market research and compile findings for strategic business projects.
Collaborate with business partners to identify opportunities for process improvements and enhanced advisor experiences.
Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
Knowledge of
Fundamental concepts, practices, and procedures of a professional business environment.
Financial services industry and advisor business models.
Securities Based Lending, residential mortgage lending, margin lending, and structured lending concepts.
Financial modeling, forecasting, portfolio management, and performance measurement techniques.
Pricing strategy concepts including ROE, profitability analysis, spreads, and risk-adjusted returns.
Large relational databases and business intelligence reporting tools.
Data visualization and presentation best practices.
Skill in
Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Access, and other Microsoft Office applications.
Tableau, SQL, Qlik, Power BI, and related reporting and analytics tools.
Financial analysis, quantitative modeling, and analytical problem solving.
Creating dashboards, performance reporting, and executive-level presentations.
Researching, analyzing, and interpreting complex business information.
Building effective relationships through a client-first, service-oriented mindset.
Preferred Technical Skills
Advanced Excel capabilities including formulas, pivot tables, and data analysis.
Tableau, Power BI, Qlik, or similar visualization platforms.
SQL and database querying.
Python, R, Power Query, or other analytical programming tools.
PowerPoint and executive presentation development.
Ability to
Analyze complex business problems and develop actionable recommendations.
Interpret quantitative information and communicate insights effectively to technical and non-technical audiences.
Prepare concise executive-level summaries and recommendations.
Organize, prioritize, and manage multiple assignments in a fast-paced environment.
Work independently and collaboratively across cross-functional teams.
Establish and maintain effective working relationships with advisors and internal business partners.
Communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.
Demonstrate initiative, adaptability, professionalism, curiosity, and attention to detail.
Learn quickly and apply new financial, analytical, and business concepts.
Educational / Previous Experience Requirements
Junior standing (December 2027 through May 2028 graduates) pursuing a bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Analytics, Economics, Accounting, Data Science, Business Administration, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
Strong academic performance with demonstrated analytical aptitude preferred.
Any equivalent combination of experience, education, and/or training approved by Human Resources.
Eligible applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States and not require visa sponsorship now or in the future (including beyond OPT/EAD).
Licenses / Certifications
None required.
Location
Hybrid Position – St. Petersburg, FL
No travel required.

Hybrid

Company
Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta
As an employee of the Atlanta Fed, you will help support our mission of promoting the stability and efficiency of the U.S. economy and financial system. Your work will affect the economy of the Southeast, the United States, and the world. The work we do here is important, and how we do it is just as important as what we do. We live our values of integrity, excellence, and respect every day. We do the right thing, we do things right, and we treat people right. A career at the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta gives you the chance to do work that touches lives and helps communities prosper.
The Bank believes in flexibility to balance the demands of work and life while also recognizing the necessity of connecting and collaborating with our colleagues in person. Onsite work is an essential function of this position, and you are required to be onsite according to the schedule set by your management.
The Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Research Department is now hiring for our Spring and Summer 2027 Internship Program. This is an onsite/ hybrid (Preferred) or remote position eligible; candidate must be available to work 15 hours a week during the Spring semester (January – early May): Monday-Friday 8AM-5PM EST; and 30 hours a week during the Summer semester (late May – early August) during the following days/times: Monday – Friday 8AM – 5PM EST. Opportunity exists to work on-site during the Summer semester to engage in the Atlanta Fed’s broader internship program offerings. The position will start January 2027 through August 2027*.
The Research Division focuses on every aspect of the economy, from the local to the international level. At the Atlanta Fed, studies range from analyzing rural banking markets in the Southeast to designing and testing economic forecasting models used in policy making.
*date subject to change
SCOPE OF ASSIGNMENT
Payments Forum – Selected students will be conducting recruitment of depository and financial institutions, major card networks, payments processors, and card issuers through data submission and validation activities as part of the Federal Reserve Payments Study (FRPS) administered by the Atlanta Fed’s Payments Forum in partnership with the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System.
The FRPS is the most comprehensive, unbiased study of noncash payments activity in the U.S. The FRPS collects data from some 4,000 financial institutions and more than 100 network processors and issuers. Encouraging these respondents to participate and helping them to do so is the goal of the Research Interns.
More information about the FRPS can be found

posting.description:
Company
Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond
When you join the Federal Reserve—the nation's central bank—you’ll play a key role, collaborating with a dynamic team of mission-driven professionals to strengthen and protect our economy and our communities.
Bring your passion and expertise, and we’ll provide the opportunities that will challenge you and propel your growth—along with a wide range of benefits and perks that support your health, wealth, and life.
About the Opportunity
The Richmond Fed Supervision, Regulation, and Credit (SRC) department is now hiring for our 2027 Summer Internship Program. SRC is responsible for the supervision of bank holding companies, state member banks, and foreign banking organizations. Supervision is completed from two differing aspects, safety and soundness (assessing a bank’s financial performance and risk to the FDIC insurance fund) and consumer compliance (assessing a bank’s compliance with consumer guidelines such as Fair Lending and Community Reinvestment Act). SRC is also responsible for Discount Window operations where money can be lent to organizations in need of funding.
The Assistant Examiner Internship Program provides a unique experience to explore SRC’s supervision business lines and will be located in Richmond, VA. The program provides summer interns with the opportunity to enhance essential business skills and increase understanding of the Federal Reserve’s role in the supervision of financial institutions. During the program, you will gain exposure to the supervisory process through bank examination participation. While participating on bank examinations, you will interact with management at supervised institutions, review reports, participate in meetings, and assess risk exposures. You may review topics ranging from adequacy of risk management practices, operational controls, financial condition, and/or compliance with banking laws and regulations. In addition,
you
will participate in foundational learning, develop a relationship with a mentor, create and deliver presentations, and complete a final project
As part of the Bank’s larger intern cohort, you will participate in professional development activities and be provided with an extensive understanding of the work of the Federal Reserve. In addition to specific business area tasks, you will receive leadership training, mentorship and valuable networking opportunities.
What You Will Do:
Rotate through three supervision business lines.
Participate in an examination at the Federal Reserve Bank and/or a state member bank.
Communicate findings and conclusions of supervisory activities to examination staff and senior management.
Responsibly handle highly sensitive and confidential information.
Observe and participate in relevant meetings to gain an extensive overview of the department and critical examination issues.
Participate in a bank simulation exercise.
Work with other interns to create and deliver a presentation to SRC related to internship experience.
Qualifications:
Rising senior with a minimum 3.3 GPA with a preferred emphasis in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field.
Strong project management skills, including organization, planning and execution, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
Intellectual curiosity with willingness to ask questions.
Other Requirements and Considerations:
An applicant posting for employment as a Federal Reserve examiner intern must be a U.S. citizen or hold a permanent residence visa/Green Card and be an intending citizen. Sponsorship or practical training extensions are not available for this position.
Under conflicts of interest guidelines administered by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, examining personnel may not participate on an examination of a financial institution or affiliate if the examiner was employed by the financial institution or affiliate within the past 12 months.
Please review the Bank’s Code of Conduct to ensure compliance with conflicts of interest rules and personal investment restrictions. The Code is available on the About Us, Careers webpage at
www.richmondfed.org
.
FRB ethics rules generally prohibit employees and their immediate families from owning investments in banks, savings associations or their holding companies (Section 5.3). Additionally, employees engaged in Supervision and Regulation may be subject to borrowing and deposit restrictions. These employees may need to recuse themselves from certain supervisory work based on:
their borrowing relationships
if a financial institution employs a member of the employee’s immediate family
if the individual was employed by the financial institution or affiliate within the past 12 months
In certain cases, the recusal may be so extensive it could materially reduce the effectiveness of the prospective employee.
Selected candidate is subject to special background check procedures.
The hourly rate for summer interns is $23.50/hour.
Onsite presence required
Due to the volume of applicant submissions, we may be unable to contact each individual directly

Job Description
ABOUT RBC CAPITAL MARKETS
RBC Capital Markets is a premier investment bank that provides a focused set of products and services to corporations, institutional investors and governments around the world. With more than 7,100 professionals, we operate out of 70 offices in 15 countries across North America, the U.K., Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region.
We work with clients in over 100 countries to deliver the expertise and execution required to raise capital, access markets, mitigate risk and acquire or dispose of assets. According to Bloomberg and Dealogic, we are consistently ranked among the largest global investment banks. RBC Capital Markets is part of Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), one of the top 15 largest banks globally and fifth largest in North America, as measured by market capitalization. With a strong capital base and consistent financial performance, RBC is among a small group of highly rated global banks.
WHAT WILL YOU DO?
Join our Summer Analyst Program and make a real impact on the future of Capital Markets. You'll work on meaningful projects that shape how we serve clients - from building intelligent trading systems to developing data pipelines that power our decision-making. Alongside experienced technologists, you'll design, develop, and deploy tools that matter.
This isn't a passive learning experience. You'll own real deliverables in a collaborative project team setting, guided by RBC Capital Markets' lead architects and technologists. You'll gain hands-on exposure to cutting-edge technologies including machine learning, data engineering, cloud infrastructure, and algorithmic trading systems. Dedicated mentoring sessions with business-aligned technology leaders will deepen your understanding of how technology drives client value across trading, risk management, and market operations.
Beyond the work itself, you'll network with peers across Capital Markets through social events and skill-building sessions, building relationships that often lead to full-time opportunities.
You'll have the opportunity to contribute to one or more of these areas:
Architecture
– Shape the foundational systems that power modern capital markets
eTrading & Algorithmic Trading Technology
– Work on platforms that execute trades at scale with intelligence and precision
Commodities & Futures Technology
– Apply data science and automation to commodity markets
Equities Technology
– Leverage machine learning to enhance equity trading and market intelligence
Market Data Operations and Engineering
– Build systems that aggregate, process, and deliver critical market data
Fixed Income & Currencies Technology
– Develop analytical tools and trading systems for global markets
AI & Machine Learning Engineering
– Build predictive models, develop recommendation systems, and optimize trading algorithms
WHAT DO YOU NEED TO SUCCEED?
We seek talented individuals with intellectual curiosity, a drive to solve complex problems, and the energy to thrive in a fast-paced environment. You should be confident in your abilities while remaining eager to learn, collaborate, and push boundaries.
Successful candidates will be evaluated on individual merit. We're looking for:

Entering the final year of a four-year college or university program or enrolled in a relevant master's program (anticipating graduation Winter 2027 or Spring 2028)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

History of academic excellence
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Preferably pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Data Science or Business Analytics

Programming:
Python, Java, C#, C/C++, or Scala; familiarity with frameworks like .NET or J2EE
Data Science & AI:
Experience with machine learning libraries, statistical modeling, or predictive analytics
Data Engineering:
SQL and/or NoSQL databases; ETL pipeline development; familiarity with tools like Spark or Kafka
Cloud & Infrastructure:
AWS, Azure, or GCP; containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)

Version control (Git), testing frameworks, agile methodologies
Systems & DevOps:
Linux/Unix administration, CI/CD pipelines

Understanding of markets, trading concepts, or financial products

Requirements gathering and cross-functional collaboration

Job Description
WHAT IS THE OPPORTUNITY?
RBC Capital Markets
RBC Capital Markets is a premier investment bank that provides a focused set of products and services to corporations, institutional investors, and governments around the world. With more than 7,100 professionals, we operate out of 70 offices in 15 countries across North America, the U.K., Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region.
We work with clients in over 100 countries around the globe to deliver the expertise and execution required to raise capital, access markets, mitigate risk and acquire or dispose of assets. According to Bloomberg and Dealogic, we are consistently ranked among the largest global investment banks.
RBC Capital Markets is part of a leading provider of financial services, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC). Operating since 1869, RBC is one of the top 15 largest banks in the world and the fifth largest in North America, as measured by market capitalization. With a strong capital base and consistent financial performance, RBC is among a small group of highly rated global banks.
Quantitative Trading Summer Program
RBC’s quantitative trading teams are traders who program computers to trade for them. The Quantitative Trading Summer Analyst Program offers an unrivaled opportunity to work in one of these highly technical algorithmic trading groups for the summer, leading to a potential full-time offer. The teams are made up of mathematicians, software engineers, and data scientists who write and manage automated trading strategies. RBC’s strategic objective is to find excellent candidates with a STEM/Computer Science background, hire them onto our platform, and promote the ongoing development of this junior cohort to become leaders in this space.
WHAT WILL YOU DO?
As a quant trader, summer analysts can expect to:
Assist in developing trading strategies, improve the speed of trading systems, and evaluate models and technologies.
Paper trade in your team’s asset class by working with voice traders to better learn our markets.
Gain experience for the products your team trades: FX, equities, interest rates, ETFs, etc.
Become immersed in a comprehensive education program for interns and junior traders/researchers that will develop critical quantitative skills and decision-making capabilities.
WHAT DO YOU NEED TO SUCCEED?
In selecting summer analysts and considering full-time offers, we look for the following:
Anticipated graduation in Winter 2027 or Spring 2028 at an accredited four-year college or university or master’s program.
Engaged in study of Math, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field.
Strong programming skills, with experience in python and at least one compiled language (Java or C++).
Ability to manage multiple competing priorities and thrive in a fast-paced and challenging environment.
The most successful people on our teams apply the following principles:
Be reliable. Product quality code, meet deadlines, follow through on commitments, anticipate and prevent problems.
Be proactive. Apply even judgement and have the ambition to figure things out on your own.
Be diligent. Respond strategically to operational issues to instill confidence in our processes.
Be curious. Continually improve your skills. Take time to deliberately practice new skills and technologies that excite you.
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?
You should expect the following if you join us:
Gain a strong sense of ownership and pride for your work—we write code for ourselves, not for customers or a third party.
Understand what it would be like to have a career in quantitative trading, and work in a leading algo trading team.
Learn about high-frequency markets, how to write high-performance code, and how mathematics and statistics get applied in a trading business.
Learn how a professional electronic trading team manages the complexity of their stack and their market.
Network with other teams to explore career possibilities across finance.
The good-faith expected salary range for the above position is $110,000 depending on factors including but not limited to the candidate’s experience, skills, registration status; market conditions; and business needs. posting.description:
The Red Hat OpenShift AI (RHOAI) team is looking for a Software Engineer Intern to join us in Ireland. Our focus is to create a platform, partner ecosystem, and community by which enterprise customers can solve problems to accelerate business success using AI. This is a very exciting opportunity to build and impact the next generation of hybrid cloud MLOps platforms, contribute to the development of the RHOAI product, participate in open source communities, and be at the forefront of the exciting evolution of AI. You’ll join an ecosystem that fosters continuous learning, career growth, and professional development.
At Red Hat, you’ll work in an environment that welcomes diverse perspectives, values great ideas, and empowers individuals to contribute meaningfully. Freedom and courage are two of our core values — which means you’ll have the space to take risks, explore the unknown, and grow your strengths. But being a Red Hatter is not just about bravery; it’s also about commitment and follow-through.
Red Hat’s Intern Program is a collaborative effort between the Emerging Talent team and our intern managers. The program is designed to offer a meaningful and well-rounded experience — combining professional development, networking opportunities, social engagement, and impactful work. This is a paid, full-time internship based in the Dublin office, with flexible working hours. The expected start date is January 2027.
What you will do:
Perform engineering tasks under the direction of an experienced engineer
Become an active member of an agile development team, both scrum and kanban
Learn to collaborate and innovate with other engineers in your team
Troubleshoot technical issues and help deliver creative solutions
Work both on your own, remotely, and collaboratively with others in your team
Help mentor a transition year student, transferring your learned skills to the younger students
Contribute to the open-source community
Present a topic, not always technical, to the Cloud Services team at one or more of our Lunch & Learn events
Proactively utilize AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) for code generation, auto-completion, and intelligent suggestions to accelerate development cycles and enhance code quality.
What you will bring:
Currently enrolled in an accredited university degree in computer science or a related technical field within the Republic of Ireland, with full-time availability from January through August 2027 for the entire internship duration.
Growth mindset; willingness to learn and challenge yourself
Ability to give and receive feedback in a meaningful manner
Passion for problem-solving and debugging technical issues
Some working knowledge/understanding of Git usage and workflows (Git workshops are provided for all interns when they join).
A good understanding of scripting and programming with languages such Python, Golang
A basic understanding or knowledge of Linux operating systems
Some understanding of configuration management, automation tools, and containerisation technologies.
Active online presence (e.g. GitHub) with interest in community development is a plus.
Working knowledge of written and spoken English
Due to the limited number of internship opportunities and the high volume of applications, we may not be able to speak with every candidate. To maximize your chances of moving forward in the process, please ensure your CV clearly outlines your education, relevant projects (link to your git.hub account), and extracurricular activities.
Please apply for a maximum of three internship roles that best match your interests and skills.
About Red Hat
Red Hat
is the world’s leading provider of enterprise
open source
software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
Inclusion at Red Hat
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.
Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email
application-assistance@redhat.com
. General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.
