posting.description:
The Brand Graphic Design Intern, will gain hands-on experience on a global, collaborative design team, bringing our brand to life across digital and print experiences while building your portfolio with real-world marketing initiatives. Working closely alongside designers, marketers, and cross-functional partners, you will learn how a global brand maintains consistency across channels and touchpoints.
Through dedicated mentorship and feedback, you will refine your design, communication, and project management skills—gaining invaluable experience balancing creative excellence with business goals and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
What You'll Do
Depending on the needs of the team, you may:
Design and develop a variety of creative assets for digital and print channels.
Execute projects that reflect the Workiva brand and creative standards across a range of formats, including:
Digital and web experiences
Promotional and social advertising
Marketing banners
Event booths and collateral
eBooks and white papers
Presentations and sales materials
Collaborate cross-functionally with members of the Workiva Marketing team and contribute creative ideas and perspectives to projects.
Help maintain and evolve brand style guidelines, templates, and iconography.
Organize and maintain libraries of approved creative assets and brand resources.
Refine and design presentations that create a consistent and polished visual identity across sales and marketing materials.
Participate in creative reviews and incorporate feedback from your design mentor or manager before work is shared with broader stakeholders.
Gain experience working within established brand standards while learning how to apply creative thinking to solve real business challenges.
What You'll Need
Minimum Qualifications
Currently enrolled in a degree-seeking program, preferably in Graphic Design, Marketing, Visual Communications, or a related field.
A portfolio or examples of design work that you can share with our team.
Experience using Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and Microsoft Office Suite.
Preferred Qualifications
Previous coursework or hands-on experience in a Graphic Design or Visual Communications program.
Experience creating a range of digital and print marketing materials.
An interest in brand design, marketing, visual storytelling, and creative systems.
Experience working collaboratively and incorporating feedback into creative work.
Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. We work remotely, so clear and consistent communication is essential.
Strong time management skills and the ability to confidently manage deadlines and deliver projects on time.
Comfort working independently in a remote environment and managing your own time and priorities.
A self-motivated mindset with a strong drive for action, results, learning, and continuous improvement.
The ability to thrive in a high-energy, fast-paced, and rapidly changing environment.
Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, processes, and priorities simultaneously.
Travel Requirements & Working Conditions
Minimal travel
Reliable internet access for any period of time working remotely and not in a Workiva office
Location:

Workplace Flexibility
to learn more.

We are committed to attending all career fairs and recruitment events before closing our positions. That means, this position might be open without updates for a few weeks to give us time to connect with all potential candidates before wrapping up the recruitment season. Monday, January 4, 2027 (15-20 hours per week max)
Summer 2027 Internships
: Monday, May 17, 2027 (40/hours per week max)
How You’ll Be Rewarded
✅ Salary range in the US: $22.00 - $22.00
✅ 401(k) participation and match
✅ Paid sick leave
✅ A unique opportunity to further your learning experience through additional internship seasons
Why Join Workiva
Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.
At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

Xcel Energy is seeking candidates to support our CFO Organization, specifically, within our Load Research or Energy and Demand Forecasting teams. - Assist with analysis used for planning, budgeting, regulatory, and business decision-making.
- Help improve tools, reports, and processes that support recurring forecasting and research work.
- Explore how customer behavior, weather, and new technologies may affect energy use.
- Learn forecasting concepts and contribute to projects that strengthen future forecasting capabilities.

Xcel Energy is seeking candidates to support our Customer Energy and Transportation Solutions (CETS) organization, specifically within the Product Planning and Strategy team in Minneapolis, MN or Denver, CO. This paid internship offers a unique opportunity to work on high-impact analytical projects that support the planning, evaluation, and regulatory reporting of demand-side management (DSM) programs serving customers across our service territory. The intern will work directly with technical consultants to evaluate the cost-effectiveness and financial performance of DSM programs for Northern States Power-Minnesota (NSP-M) and Public Service Company (PSCo). A key responsibility of the role will be supporting the development of cost-benefit analyses and associated documentation for regulatory filings, including ownership of analytical components supporting the Company's South Dakota DSM filing.
In addition to regulatory and financial analysis activities, the intern will help identify and implement process improvements that enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of program planning and reporting. This includes evaluating opportunities for new dashboards, automated reporting tools, and business intelligence solutions that provide ongoing visibility into program financial incentives, cost-effectiveness metrics, and mid-year program performance. The internship provides hands-on experience with utility program planning, financial analysis, cost-effectiveness testing, and data-driven decision-making. The successful candidate will gain exposure to how utilities evaluate energy efficiency investments, support regulatory compliance, and develop customer-focused programs that advance clean energy goals. Throughout the program, the intern will collaborate with cross-functional teams, develop professional analytical skills, and present project findings and recommendations to business leaders.
Typical intern responsibilities may include but are not limited to:
Support cost-benefit and financial analysis of demand-side management programs for NSP-M.
Assist in preparing analytical support and documentation for regulatory filings, including South Dakota DSM filings.
Maintain and enhance cost-effectiveness models, tools, and business processes.
Analyze program performance and incentive data to identify trends and opportunities.
Develop dashboards and reporting solutions that improve visibility into program and portfolio performance.
Identify and recommend process improvements that enhance analytical efficiency and reporting accuracy.
Present findings, insights, and recommendations to technical consultants and business leadership.

posting.description:
Job Description
We are seeking a creative, engaged, and curious intern to join us this summer and support internal process improvements for scaling the Global Revenue Operations (RevOps) team. This nine-week, full-time position offers flexibility to accommodate class schedules and personal commitments. The position is hybrid so you will have the flexibility to work remotely and have the opportunity to come to the office and meet the team. You will have a dedicated Mentor partnering with you to help you grow and develop during your internship. We are aiming for an early June start date and prefer someone who can commit to 40 hours per week during the summer, with 2-3 days spent working on-site at the Madison Zendesk office.
As part of our commitment to innovation, we'll leverage AI and automation to enhance product monetization capabilities. This involves using data-driven insights to optimize pricing strategies, improving operational efficiency, and ensuring seamless workflows to maintain auditability across transactions.
The on-site work will provide valuable opportunities for in-person engagement and collaboration, allowing you to closely interact with team members, participate in brainstorming sessions, and get hands-on experience with projects. This face-to-face interaction is crucial for fostering stronger professional relationships, enhancing communication, and creating a supportive environment for creativity and innovation. We believe that in-person collaboration will significantly contribute to your personal and professional growth, ensuring you gain the most from this internship experience.
We take pride in our ability to serve our internal and external customers through industry-leading responsiveness. As such, if you take initiative, enjoy having autonomy to move quickly, and are searching for an opportunity where you can learn about complex software transactions, process optimization, establishing best practices and the Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) industry, we’d love to hear from you.
At Zendesk, diversity, equity and inclusion are more than buzzwords, and bigger than the bottom line. It's about our people knowing that they're valued where they work. Employees at Zendesk work hard to build a culture where everyone belongs. Employee Communities play a vital role in bringing us together and ensure we feel supported at work.
What We’re Looking For:
Phenomenal communication and collaboration skills, both written and verbal.
A natural curiosity (no question too small!) and a robust personality with high levels of energy and motivation to exceed expectations.
Able to demonstrate initiative by speaking up when identifying process improvement opportunities
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Superior organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
A strong interest in business operations and process optimization.
A professional work ethic with a technical aptitude and a desire to take ownership of projects, learn from mistakes, and have fun.
Ability to learn quickly in a remote environment.
A self-starter! Ability to take direction and run with it.
Key Responsibilities:
Support the implementation of departmental process improvement and automation initiatives within the RevOps team, including AI-driven optimizations.
Focus on project-based work to assist in integrating our legacy customers into our core systems from merger and acquisition activities.
Support and execute User Acceptance Testing within our commerce-to-cash systems.
Document system workflows and process improvements relating to quoting, billing, and provisioning processes/systems.
Perform ad hoc analysis, respond to insight requests, and conduct data extractions to resolve critical business issues.
Develop and maintain various help center articles and enablement materials.
Assist in key data migrations for new system implementations and departmental initiatives.
Assist in setting up key billing accounts to streamline future selling models.
Support the implementation of departmental process improvement and automation initiatives within the RevOps team.
Learn the ins and outs of key systems (Stripe, Zuora, SalesForce, CPQ, Zendesk Support).
Gain knowledge and experience across different Corporate Services functions (Accounting, Finance, Sales, Legal).
Requirements:
Actively enrolled in a degree program in Economics, Business, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
Strong knowledge of G-Suite and Zoom applications.
Familiarity or prior experience with Salesforce, Zuora, or another CRM tool is preferred but not mandatory.
Must be authorized to work in the United States.
We prefer a qualified individual who resides in Madison, WI, or the immediate vicinity to facilitate better in-office collaboration and engagement.
The US hourly base rate range for this position is $26.44-$39.90. This position may also be eligible for bonus, benefits, or related incentives. While this range reflects the minimum and maximum value for new hire rates for the position across all US locations, the offer for the successful candidate for this position will be based on job related capabilities, applicable experience, and other factors such as work location. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base rate only (or OTE for commissions based roles), and do not include bonus, benefits, or related incentives.
Hybrid: In this role, our hybrid experience is designed at the team level to give you a rich onsite experience packed with connection, collaboration, learning, and celebration - while also giving you flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. This role must attend our local office for part of the week. The specific in-office schedule is to be determined by the hiring manager.

Job Description
Financial Analysis & Strategy Analyst Intern
The Finance & Strategy team serves as trusted advisors to the company, informing and guiding critical C-level decisions through insightful analyses & thought-partnership. We are looking for bright, driven individuals who will succeed in a fast-paced environment and support our team in making sound recommendations that will allow the company to scale to the multi-Billion era.
This ten-week, full-time position will run from June 7, 2027, to August 6, 2027.
The primary functions of a Financial Analyst Intern are to deliver high-precision forecasting via financial models to deliver actionable insights, which will support you on your path to become a well-rounded finance professional. Our Intern Analysts are positioned to directly contribute to the success of the F&S team. Your impact will be felt immediately as you develop finance and business acumen to support Zendesk in this role.

Analyze financial results, distill and synthesize key trends, and communicate key risks & opportunities to influence business outcomes
Build and maintain financial models to inform key business decisions
Manage organizational budgets and partner with executives to empower them to invest with impact
Implement improvements & automation to streamline current processes
Build on foundation of strong relationships with our partners across the organization and drive cross-functional alignment
Own high-precision forecasting and relevant scenarios for topline metrics
Assist in preparation of monthly & quarterly P&L management reporting
Tackle new & evolving priorities for the team, including ad hoc analyses
Minimum Requirements:
Currently pursuing a bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or other Technical discipline with planned graduation in Spring 2028.
Experience with modeling and working with data
Strong experience utilizing Gsuite, Excel and other Office tools
Strong experience utilizing ChatGPT and other LLM tools

Positive attitude with an analytical and AI-first mindset
Desire to learn new things quickly
